answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 30 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 14 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 30 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 580 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The cedar test is the live device, the comet test is the locked stake, and the shale test is the graded history no template can fake.
